description: An elderly man with a wild mane of grey hair and a short white beard sits hunched forward, shown full figure from head to boots, facing the viewer at eye level. His face and hands are ruddy pink. He wears a loose grey shirt patterned with small cyan and white diamond flecks, rough brown trousers and dark red shoes. One hand is raised to his chin and mouth in thought; the other rests on his knee. The setting is a dark room with a black background, thin orange lines suggesting the edges of a wall, a doorway and a floor. The mood is quiet, worried and contemplative. Frame 1: he sits still with hand at chin. Frame 2: his eyes shift a little. Frame 3: the fingers on his knee move. Frame 4: his eyes glance aside. Frame 5: his fingers tap again. Frame 6: he returns toward the first pose. The frames are short and uneven, the fifth held a little longer, so the loop reads as a fidgeting thinker drumming his fingers and glancing about.
title: Old man pondering on a stool
